fact: Zanzibar's ZSSF, ZHSF, ZUPS, TASAF and MoCDGEC welfare programmes operate separate, independently developed information systems with no common identifier for households or individuals, so duplicates cannot be resolved across programmes.
title: What would it take to establish a unified, dynamic social registry in support of poverty reduction in Zanzibar?
publisher: ZRCP / DEEP programme, Oxford Policy Management
